quote_boxes.en: But, if you knew this whole time, why didn't you just tell me about my role in all this? Wouldn't that make everything go a lot faster?
quote_boxes.speaker: Mualani
quote_boxes.t: 그런데, 처음부터 알고 계셨다면 왜 제 역할에 대해 말해주지 않으셨나요? 그러면 모든 게 훨씬 빨리 진행됐을 텐데요.
